Why is it important to have strong muscles?
Strong muscles aren't just about how you look — they're the foundation of how you move through life. They support your posture, your balance, your everyday movement, and your body's ability to stay steady and stable as you age.
For both men and women, building muscle strength is very important. It's essential for healthy bones, healthy joints, and a body that stays resilient for years to come.
